server_address.hint: Host and port of your ComfyUI instance. Use the LAN IP if ComfyUI runs in a different container/host than AstrBot — 127.0.0.1 will point at AstrBot itself, not ComfyUI.

workflow_json.hint: Paste the full contents of your exported workflow here (ComfyUI: File → Export Workflow (API), then open the .json file in a text editor and copy everything). This is the recommended way to set your workflow — no file upload or plugin re-zip needed, just paste and Save. Leave this blank to use the file-based method below instead (workflow_file).

workflow_file.hint: Only used if workflow_json above is left blank. The API-format JSON file placed in this plugin's workflow/ folder.

positive_prompt_node_id.hint: The node ID of your CLIP Text Encode (or equivalent) node that receives the positive prompt. Find it in ComfyUI with developer mode enabled — the ID is shown above the node title.

negative_prompt_node_id.hint: Leave blank if your workflow has no negative prompt node.

output_node_id.hint: The node ID of your Save Image / Preview Image node.

seed_node_id.hint: Leave blank to auto-detect a node with a 'seed' or 'noise_seed' input and randomize it. Set explicitly only if auto-detection picks the wrong node.

default_negative_prompt.hint: Used when negative_prompt_node_id is set and no negative prompt is given.

poll_timeout_seconds.hint: How long to wait for ComfyUI to finish before giving up.

img2img_workflow_json.hint: Optional. Paste a separate workflow exported from ComfyUI that starts from LoadImage + VAEEncode instead of EmptyLatentImage. Leave blank to disable image-to-image (attached images will be ignored and treated as text-to-image). See README for how to build this workflow.

img2img_workflow_file.hint: Only used if img2img_workflow_json above is left blank.

img2img_load_image_node_id.hint: The node ID of the LoadImage node that receives the uploaded photo. Required for image-to-image to work.

img2img_positive_prompt_node_id.hint: May differ from the text-to-image workflow's node IDs — check in ComfyUI developer mode.

img2img_denoise_node_id.hint: Leave blank to auto-detect (usually the same sampler node as the seed).

default_denoise.hint: How much the image is allowed to change from the original. Lower (e.g. 0.3) stays close to the source image; higher (e.g. 0.8) allows major changes. Typical range: 0.4-0.75.
